report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normal. Medial menisküs ekstrüde görünümde olup posterior hornunda yırtık ile uyumlu sinyal değişiklikleri mevcuttur. Arka çapraz bağ, çm çapraz bağ , lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursada sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Tibia proksimali ve femur distal epikondil seviyesi medialde kemik iliği ödemi ile uyumlu görünümler mevcuttur. Bu düzeyde eklem aralığı belirgin daralmıştır.Popliteal fossada 54x15 mm çapta Baker kisti ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur.

ΜΤ ΑΡ ΓΟΝΑΤΟΣ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ: Η εξέταση έγινε σε µαγνητικό τοµογράφο 3Τ µε ακολουθίες PDFS και T1. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ -Σηµειώνεται µικροί επιχείλιοι οστεοφυτικοί σχηµατισµοί αντίστοιχα µε το έσω και έξω διαµέρισµα της κατά γόνυ άρθρωσης µε κατά τόπους λέπτυνση του αρθρικού χόνδρου ιδία αντίστοιχα µε τον έσω µηριαίο και έξω κνηµιαίο κόνδυλο (ICRS grade IΙ-ΙΙΙ), καθώς και παθολογικό σήµα στον αρθρικό χόνδρο της επιγονατίδας, ευρήµατα στο πλαίσιο ήπιων οστεοαρθριτικών αλλοιώσεων. Συνυπάρχει υπεξάρθρηµα-εκφυλιστική ρήξη στο σώµα και οπίσθιο κέρας του έσω µηνίσκου πιθανά επεκτεινόµενη στην οπίσθια ρίζα αυτού. -Φυσιολογικοί απεικονίζονται οι χιαστοί και πλάγιοι σύνδεσµοι καθώς και ο έξω µηνίσκος. -Φυσιολογική η απεικόνιση, της λαγονοκνηµιαίας ταινίας της οπίσθιας έξω γωνίας και της εγγύς κνηµοπερονιαίας άρθρωσης. -Φυσιολογική η απεικόνιση της οπίσθιας έσω γωνίας και του χηνείου ποδός. -Μικρή ενδαρθρική συλλογή υγρού. Παρουσία υπερεπιγονατιδικής υµενικής πτυχής. -Με σήµα εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο οστικός µυελός. Παρουσία διευρυσµένων αγγειακών κλάδων στην άπω µηριαία διάφυση -Οιδηµατώδης απεικόνιση του υποδόριου κυτταρολιπώδους ιστού αντίστοιχα µε την οπίσθια-έσω µοίρα του γόνατος.

ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ: Η εξέταση έγινε µε ακολουθίες παλµών Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων µε καταστολή του σήµατος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθµιδωτής ηχούς. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Φυσιολογικοί απεικονίζονται οι πλάγιοι και χιαστοί σύνδεσµοι καθώς και ο έσω και έξω µηνίσκος. Από τον έλεγχο του προσθίου διαµερίσµατος οι τένοντες επιγονατιδικός και τετρακέφαλος καθώς και η επιγονατίδα ελέγχονται εντός του φυσιολογικού. Ο αρθρικός χόνδρος του έξω τµήµατος της επιγονατίδας, παρουσιάζει σχισµοειδή διάβρωση (fissuring). Εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο λοιπός αρθρικός χόνδρος. Ενδαρθρικά παρατηρείται µικρή συλλογή υγρού και υµενίτιδα. Με σήµα εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο οστικός µυελός. Μικρή συνοβιακή κύστη Baker παρατηρείται στην έσω ιγνυακή κοιλότητα.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Moderate joint effusion with synovitis. Baker's cyst, with further multiloculated ganglion cyst associated with the insertional fibers of semimembranosus.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Incomplete/moderate grade partial radial tear involving the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is meniscal extrusion of approximately 4 mm at the level of the body segment. Intrasubstance hyperintense signal in keeping with degenerative facet changes most pronounced at the body.

Some areas of high-grade and full-thickness chondral loss involving the weightbearing portions of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. Mild marginal osteophytosis, with subchondral cystic changes, sclerosis and reactive bone marrow signal edema in keeping with moderate osteoarthritis.

There is a focal approximately 1 x 1 cm area of subchondral sclerosis and cystlike changes, mild subchondral bone plate irregularity, and associated edema-like bone marrow reactive changes at the medial aspect of the medial tibial plateau, which raises the suspicion of sequela of a subchondral insufficiency fracture.

Mild edema deep to the medial collateral ligament suggesting reactive changes. There is some mass effect on the superficial medial collateral ligament by the extruded medial meniscus.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Longitudinal horizontal tear within the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.

Mild diffuse chondral thinning. Heterogenous signal intensity of the cartilage in keeping with mild chondropathy.

Some increased signal intensity noted at the popliteus tendon suggesting mild tendinosis. Otherwise, normal lateral collateral ligamentous structures.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Mucoid degeneration of the ACL. Normal PCL.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Normal extensor mechanism.

Loose body versus nodular synovitis anterior to the trochlea groove (series 5, image 18), measuring 9 x 5 x 4 mm.
Mild diffuse chondral thinning.

Bones:
Mild bone marrow edema like signal at the proximal tibiofibular joint, likely degenerative.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Severe medial compartment osteoarthritis with a moderate grade partial radial tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus and associated extrusion of the medial meniscal body.
2.There is a 1 cm area of subchondral sclerosis, cystlike changes, mild subchondral bone plate depression, and surrounding bone marrow edema at the medial tibial plateau, raising suspicion for sequelae of a subchondral insufficiency fracture.
3.Longitudinal horizontal tear within the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
4.Mild chondropathy at the medial and patellofemoral compartments.
5.A 9 mm structure is noted anterior to the trochlea, suggesting an intra-articular body.
6.Moderate joint effusion and synovitis. Small popliteal cyst and multiloculated ganglion cyst about the semimembranosus tendon insertion.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Three-week history of left knee pain after slipping on a wet floor and slamming knee into wall.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Osseous contusion involving the anterior peripheral aspect of the medial femoral condyle. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Tricompartmental marginal spurring, most notably along the medial tibiofemoral compartment.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate complex multilobulated Baker's cyst with calcified bodies and synovial proliferation.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex degenerative tearing involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn medial meniscus with severe meniscal extrusion of the body and displaced fragment within the meniscotibial recess. Superimposed reactive marrow edema at the medial tibial margin.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse full-thickness cartilage loss about the weightbearing medial femoral condyle with scattered areas of subchondral marrow edema and cystic change. Additional diffuse cartilage loss along the anterior and central medial tibial plateau with scattered subchondral marrow edema.


LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Degenerative signal posterior horn and posterior root with suspected degenerative tearing at the posterior horn-posterior root junction. No meniscal extrusion or displaced fragment.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss/fraying about the central weightbearing lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal partial thickness chondrosis central femoral trochlea. Patellar cartilage is intact. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Bowing of the medial meniscus secondary to adjacent medial meniscal pathology. Otherwise intact.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Grade 1 sprain characterized by periligamentous edema.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific subcutaneous soft tissue edema about the anterior knee. Mild deep infrapatellar bursitis. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Osseous contusion involving the anterior peripheral medial femoral condyle.
2.	Complex tearing of the anterior horn to posterior horn medial meniscus with severe meniscal extrusion of the body and displaced fragment within the meniscotibial recess.
3.	Tricompartmental chondrosis and osteoarthritis, severe involving the medial tibiofemoral compartment.
4.	Grade 1 sprain LCL.
5.	Moderate complex Baker's cyst containing multiple calcified bodies.

Clinical information: 7 days post soccer injury with valgus shift. Medial collateral ligament testing positive. Medial collateral ligament tear? Partial posterior cruciate ligament tear?

Technique: Unenhanced point tender multiphase MRI of the left knee performed at 3.0 Tesla MRI scanner.

Findings:
The medial and lateral meniscus are intact.

There is a slightly increased T2 signal within the midportion of the anterior cruciate ligament. The anterior cruciate ligament as a construct is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. The collateral ligaments are intact.

The extensor mechanism of the knee is unremarkable.

There is a focal avulsed, unhealed bone fragment at the inferior patellar pole. There is no focal bone marrow edema.

There is a focal area of extensive subchondral bone marrow edema in the weightbearing portion of the lateral tibial plateau with associated, nondisplaced subchondral fracture (17-9). There is a focal area of subcortical bone marrow edema at the anterolateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and at the anteromedial aspect of the medial femoral condyle.

There is a minimal superficial chondrosis in the medial femorotibial joint compartment. There is a moderate patellofemoral chondrosis with focal superficial cartilage delamination at the medial patellar facet measuring 0.4 cm from medial to lateral.

There is mild joint effusion. There is a low volume Baker's cyst. The Infrapatellar fat pad is intact.

Conclusion:
1. Nondisplaced, subchondral fracture of the lateral tibial plateau with associated bone marrow edema. Posttraumatic contusions at the anterior aspect of the medial and lateral femoral condyles.
2. Low-grade partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. No acute injury of the medial collateral ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.
3. Previous unhealed avulsion fracture at the inferior patellar pole.
4. Moderate patellofemoral chondrosis with a focal area of cartilage delamination at the medial patellar facet.
